_comment: The replication package's rights, shipped as a library layer (warehouse §4.2, owner decision 2026-10-20). One slot
the application binds in its own security.json, or startup is refused:
Approvers read the replication requests and decide them (ApproveReplication, RejectReplication); the program unit
is hidden from everyone else. Every signed-in user reads and retries or dismisses their own write-backs (the
SparkSyncAction row rule narrows every read to the initiator). Grants for modules (Replicate/{Collection}) stay the
application's: they name its own collections.
